hotel_search_unavailable: Hotel search is unavailable. Please retry.
hotel_search_refundable: Refunds are subject to cancellation deadlines and fees. Review the room terms before paying.
hotel_save_scope: Hotel dates and guests must match the selected trip.
hotel_selected_note: Hotel selected from LiteAPI results. Total for the entire stay; not booked. Prices may change before booking.
hotel_selection_added: Hotel selection added to the trip.
hotel_lite_info: LiteAPI hotel search for your dates and guests. Only public rates with validated tax details are displayed. Prices may change before booking.
hotel_no_results: No eligible rates found. Try another area or dates.
hotel_booking_pending: LiteAPI booking is not yet enabled.
hotel_checkout_intro: Choose a room and review its terms. LiteAPI handles hotel payment through its payment portal, separately from Trip Pass.
hotel_checkout_login: Sign in to your SortTrip account to continue the hotel booking.
hotel_checkout_working: Processing hotel checkout. Do not pay or create another booking.
hotel_checkout_accept: I have reviewed the dates, guests, price, and cancellation policy and agree to the booking terms. Contact and guest details are sent to LiteAPI for the reservation.
hotel_checkout_continue: Check final price & proceed to payment
hotel_checkout_ready: Complete payment through the portal, then confirm the reservation. Payment alone does not establish hotel confirmation.
hotel_checkout_refundable: Refunds depend on the deadlines and cancellation fees below; cancellation is not always free.
hotel_checkout_nonrefundable: This rate is non-refundable. Review the terms before paying.
hotel_checkout_sandbox: Sandbox testing — not a real reservation. Use the provider's test card, never a real card.
hotel_checkout_not_ready: Hotel checkout is not active yet. Payment SDK and LiteAPI account access are being verified.
hotel_checkout_invalid: Check the hotel, dates, and guest count.
hotel_checkout_guests: Complete the contact and lead guest details for each room and accept the terms.
hotel_checkout_storage: Checkout storage is unavailable. Payment has not started.
hotel_checkout_supplier: The provider's room selection or price could not be verified.
hotel_checkout_missing: Checkout was not found in this account.
hotel_checkout_locked: This checkout is processing or cannot continue at this stage. Check its status first.
hotel_checkout_changed: The room price or terms changed. Payment has not started; search again and review the latest options.
hotel_checkout_prebook_failed: The final price or payment session could not be verified. Payment has not started.
hotel_checkout_unknown: Reservation status is uncertain. Check the status or contact Help with the checkout reference. Do not pay or create another booking.
hotel_checkout_unavailable: Checkout could not be processed. Check its status if payment or booking has already started.
hotel_checkout_sdk_failed: The payment portal could not load. Do not pay outside the official portal.
hotel_checkout_failed: The checkout session could not be verified. If you have paid, contact Help before trying again.
hotel_checkout_cancelled: The provider reports that the booking was cancelled. Refund status needs separate confirmation.
google_route_consent: Search only runs when you press the button. The selected origin, destination and time are sent to Google Maps. AI quota is unchanged.
google_route_empty: Google Maps found no matching route.
google_route_fare_unknown: Fare unavailable; this does not mean free.
google_route_notice: Schedules and fares may change. Results are temporary and do not replace bookings or itinerary costs.
google_route_not_ready: Google Maps Routes is not active. The administrator must configure the key, enable the service and prepare usage limits.
google_route_login: Sign in to check Google Maps routes.
google_route_invalid: Check the origin, destination and travel mode.
google_route_date: Transit time must be within the past 7 days or the next 100 days. Check departure time.
google_route_limit: The Google Maps request limit has been reached. Retry in the next period.
google_route_budget_not_ready: Google Maps usage limits are not ready. No request was sent to Google.
google_route_unavailable: Google Maps routes are unavailable. Please retry later.
hotel_checkout_expired: This room selection expired. Search for rooms again before continuing.
hotel_checkout_search_again: Search rooms again for these dates
hotel_checkout_session_failed: LiteAPI could not create the payment session for this room. Payment has not opened.
hotel_checkout_rates_filtered: Rates are available, but do not meet SortTrip checkout requirements, such as tax details or public rate type. Choose another hotel; this does not mean all rooms are sold out.
hotel_content_source: Hotel information from LiteAPI. Photos and reviews depend on available data.
hotel_room_photos_note: Room type reference photos; bookable choices follow the supplier room name at checkout.
hotel_reviews_empty: No guest reviews are available from the provider.
hotel_reviews_unavailable: Reviews could not be loaded. Hotel details are still available.
transport_unknown_departure: Departure airport or terminal not yet specified
admission_reference: Per-person tariff reference, checked {{date}}. Check visitor eligibility and current terms; excluded from the IDR total.
admission_source: Check prices and terms at the source
admission_unknown: Admission has not been verified. Do not assume this attraction is free.
connections_missing: Add a starting point and destination to check directions.
transport_dated_quote: Per-adult fare for {{date}} · Passengers searched: {{adults}} · Displayed taxes included. The price may change before checkout.
booking_sync_explanation: Statuses distinguish your own record, a partner-reported purchase and a confirmed reservation. Opening a booking link does not confirm a purchase.
booking_save_first: Save the itinerary before booking so partner confirmations can be matched automatically. Purchases through older links may not be traceable.
booking_sync_partial: Some partner statuses could not be verified. Manual records remain available; no result does not mean the purchase failed.
booking_confirmed_help: Reservation confirmation comes from a Nuitée booking record, not a payment redirect.
booking_reported_help: A purchase is recorded in Travelpayouts affiliate reports. This does not verify an airline PNR or ticket issuance.
booking_pending_help: The partner report has not supplied a final confirmation.
booking_cancelled_help: Cancellation does not prove a refund has been received. Cost records are not removed automatically.
booking_login: Sign in to check purchase status.
booking_unavailable: Purchase status could not be verified. Try again later.
booking_limit: Wait a moment before checking status again.
booking_missing: The saved itinerary was not found in this account.
booking_changed: The itinerary changed. Save it and prepare the booking link again.
booking_tracking_unavailable: Purchase tracking is unavailable. You can still open booking and record the purchase manually afterwards.
booking_marker_required: Purchase tracking is not configured. Booking remains available through the original link.
booking_flight_report_checked: Flight purchase reports checked. An affiliate report does not prove airline ticket issuance.
booking_flight_no_match: Flight reports checked; no purchase matches this itinerary’s booking link yet.
booking_flight_status_unavailable: The partner could not verify the flight purchase status.
